notes.title: Progress Devlog #5 - New Location, New Systems and Thank you!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody! I know it's been a little while since we last posted any update on our current progress on the game, but we're still hard at work on the project and we've cooked up a couple new systems, as well as an entirely new upcoming location which, I'm gonna show you in this post.

First things first though. Thank you so much for 90 wishlists, we really appreciate every person who takes interest in our game and we are doing our best to create something that we want others to really enjoy, so again thank you for following the development of our game and we can't wait to show more for you.
And we have prepared a little comic just for you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/15b435c99085ab83fe83ea8b2072a301d1847c49.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/e7d6fc2bc2d7cd91bd1776f96027ce54b7f6dbc6.png"][/img]
Now let's start with the new things

[/p][h2]Randomly Generated Levels[/h2][p]Initially we planned out our game to have more linear sort of levels, rather than random generation every run, however we quickly realized that, that scenario would become boring quite quickly and for that reason we decided to work on a newly made random generation system

Please note that these are early development footages and we are still working on improving things and these are just to showcase the base function of what we are making.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/fd23966c590870d3e722ca3ecff13803796073fd.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/f43ca4517cbb1702f8eb44bca0d6ad47a3c60463.gif"][/img]
The maps will have a beginning point, a couple tasks to do around the map while clearing out the rooms and the final boss door that will open after completing the said tasks. Of course there will also be the shop rooms in which you will be able to buy weapons, spells and new items! We want to try to give each location it's own distinct mini-bosses and bosses as well other features like in factory the breakable viles of acid. And as you have noticed we have started work on the new location!

[/p][h2]The Dead Wild West[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/c73bb3ee2144902b023dbcc5f40592b11a07ebc5.gif"][/img]
The incredibly hot, sunny landscape of waves of sand, in which only a couple other surviving plants reside around had now also met the sudden waves of undead coming into it. The slayers here will have to beware of the quicksand and the aforementioned hot sun, burning them down.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/8770e5d4fdfb889c5d0c26a3d3491475f4a622d0.jpg"][/img]
We are still working on adding more to this and older locations obviously, this is still a work in progress, but we're pretty happy with how it's looking so far!

And now moving onto our last new addition.

[/p][h2]The Item System[/h2][p]
During each run players alongside spells and weapons will now also be able to obtain different passive items which can help changing the general playstyle and overall handling of each run. Items can range from stat improvements to complete additions to your moveset and help you a lot, for example first item, "Garden Petals" Make you shoot out a hoaming petal every few seconds that would circle towards the nearest enemy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/da4a3541c17a910aa76fe461eb389b8b09ba64ed.gif"][/img]
Or another one which makes you explode on taking damage!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/729435e02d4ae5afe9e94371dd1a6ff99982b677.gif"][/img]
And zapping enemies nearby and saving you from death once and dealing double damage every few seconds. There's plenty more where that came from and we're working on adding more and more.

We will also open a suggestion channel pretty soon in our discord server, so if you would like to suggest what do you think would the game benefit from, feel free to join and make a thread there, we'd be interested in hearing what you would have to say.

You can join us [url="https://discord.gg/saCHKcTFXA"]here[/url]

Thanks to everyone who is looking out for the game, we appreciate every single person and we're really excited to make more and more ahead. Thank you, good luck and have fun ^^
[/p][p]We also now have a boosty you can support us on![/p][p][url="https://boosty.to/thatfirey"]https://boosty.to/thatfirey[/url] [/p]

notes.title: Alpha Updates Changelog #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, merry christmas and happy incoming new year, let's hope the years ahead could become better for us!
As for our game, we have recently done a few major updates to our game.

First and probably the most noticable one is the addition of:
[h2]Lighting System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/d9e18bebfcb37b70bae70e77c91e4403f9839c56.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/22b2e696939d9d21b25a159d251b36c29c1a9009.png[/img]

Thanks to the Crystal Lighting System made by Kazan Games, we were able to implement a much more visually clean and satisfying shading and overall improving the quality of art. Lights react to walls, can merge with other lights and overall look pretty beautiful. We hope you enjoy the look of it as well and feel free to leave comments if you think this could be improved in some ways.

[h2]First Level: Factory[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/b98e8013324a972814008883db5fb2090a95ff18.png[/img]

[code]Metallic sealed doors, acid pools, running sawblades. This place is totally osha-approved[/code]

Now this is a very early alpha test of such level that we made within a week, but it gave us a lot of new ideas of how to exactly develop a nice feeling level, that's why we decided to instead of focusing on making one whole map, now reformating into semi-randomly generated levels, where whole level is separated into different rooms that interconnect between eachother. Right on the gif it shows just a pre-made concept level for it and things are still subject to change on it, but that's a start for us with that!

[h2]New weapon functions[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/9fbff5b62b5cddd08e4b12c68f6eb00757d8f200.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/4928ef73d606b9a21565ea224e6566e9671613eb.png[/img]

We also started on experimenting with giving older weapons better functionality, shotguns are now chargable, as well as us adding a new type of shotgun... well rather a cannon. Or to be exact Railcannon, which is a new strong, but long reload weapon which is able to pierce through low-health enemies, wiping out a bunch of green ghosts or soul-eaters on the way. Also in addition electric shotgun is now able to charge up giant electric balls, that shock anything on it's path!

[h2]And other improvements, as well as Jolly Ghosts :3[/h2]

We also added pretty neat character art to main menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/3cb5bed94ed734f6a1ce7e9df34e4996129809c5.gif[/img]

And made some enemies and stuff jolly for the ocassion (thanks zack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/86e919639f1f5e3f17dab4d4e621d8beb4bcef52.png[/img]

Overall we're pretty happy with the work we've done this month and looking forward in bringing more stuff in the game, currently we're experimenting with items system, reworking the rooms and other things, we're really excited to show more and more as it comes to reality in our game. Thanks for sticking with us, thanks for readin this and once again. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year ^^

notes.title: Alpha Updates Changelog #3
notes.content:
Heya been a hot minute since we posted an update on what's new in our game. We are still hard at work on everything and let us post the exact new stuff we've been working on.

[list]
[*]New weapons:
[list]
[*]Fishing Rod - attaches to enemies and throws them into different directions
[*]Spear - double attack weapon, first attack dash forward spearing everyone in your path, second attack throw your spear into enemies
[*]Crystal Revolver - Explodes an area of enemies pushing them around
[*]Electric Shotgun - Bullets cause chain lighting between nearby enemies
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/7319892870371f5f66b041a870a7a9430403e268.gif[/img]
[*]New enemy: Skeleton Mage - repeats player's spells
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/b7e1b88a1f039fc7e3cad8b76de0332d5acb8c90.gif[/img]
[*]Game enables bullet time on casting spells
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/3aad8fa33e55592b815d4b33150c1c8cda3d711f.gif[/img]
[*]New weapon select and ready-up menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/abccc61790096063629654544c5e173435696b2c.gif[/img]
[*]3 New spells: Tetherball, Explosive Bullets, Electric Bullets
[*]Added early shop prototype
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/7a9d5727b8611c4342cfe744e63613d62a9a97d7.png[/img]
[*]Added flinging enemies up into air on them being hit
[*]Optimized navigation systems
[*]Enemies now crumble into parts
[*]New interaction system
[*]You now dodge bullets at high speed
[*]Made friend friendlier
[*]And other reworks that I forgor
[/list]

Apologies for the lack of changelog for previous months, I ate it. We'd also like to welcome our new team member Zancked into the game. Welcome.

That's all for these few months, thanks for checking out and see ya later!

notes.title: Alpha Updates Changelog #2
notes.content:
As per usual we're posting the monthly changelog of the updates we've done in between August to September

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new base weapons - Baseball Bat and Ray-gun
[*] New enemies - Guard Skeleton, Soul Eater, Purple Guy
[*] A lot of new spells - Grenade Launcher, Ricochet, Fast-shooting, More Bullets Per Bullet, Passthrough Bullets, Piercing Bullets, Doppleganger and more
[*] Online leaderboard for Endless mode
[*] Added a Tutorial
[*] Added Options
[*] Added Deck building
[*] Enemies take damage from being slammed into walls
[*] Shadows
[*] Effects system
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/cd1c064c01c3399b26073538a30b74a0b8fbb1e9.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/8c63b75c62daf72a1e4fcbd467c63372178a14f4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/898b8ec97e2b311d6af2847103d4e47a6295eeb6.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/6235b904b91980f1de81a929bed7ce928dcd1b56.gif[/img]

[b]Other stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked all old enemies - Red skeletons now stomp when player is close, Green ghosts attack in hordes and etc 
[*] Removed enemy collision damage
[*] Fixed pathfinding
[*] Fixed enemies getting stuck
[*] Fixed enemies teleporting through walls
[*] Trail effects indicate when an entity can deal collision damage
[*] Reworked a lot of spells
[*] Spells that you need to hold now have a green circle around the cursor
[*] Active spell effects are shown under the player
[*] Updated visuals of spells
[*] Better physics
[*] Music system
[*] Overall bug fixes
[*] Made the friend friendlier
[/list]

And other changes we might've forgot 

In the next 3 months we'll more focus on bringing out more of what we want the game to actually be, levels, story elements as well polishing things like main menu and other things out, although generally we just work on whatever we want, be it adding more spells, more weaponary, it will all come.

Thanks again to all the playtesters for valuable feedback and criticism and thanks to everyone who is keeping tabs on our game, we really endlessly appreciate all the support and just knowing that someone would enjoy our game <3

notes.title: Alpha Updates Changelog #1
notes.content:
Game underwent a lot of changes and reworks from it's Game Jam version, just to keep things updated on Steam, we will note it down here as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147077/43148ce889b453fb1943a2e94f30cdfc279990a9.gif[/img]

Here are some of those:
[list]
[*]Added the [b]ballin'[/b] spell
[*]Added Local Coop with up to 4 players
[*]New box enemies, because boxes now hate humanity too
[*]Reworked enemy pathfinding, still not the best in all situations, but working gud
[*]Added PvP modes, from being able to just push the other players around, to full friendly fire
[*]Added the first ability of the first character of the game - Grappling Hook
[*]Red will now remember your [i][b]Ghostslays[/b][/i]
[*]The entirely new spell system, now you have to draw the sigils with your mouse!
[*]Added proper recoil to weapons like Minigun, as well as screenshaking!
[*]Added the Ice Wall spell
[*]Added a couple new testing maps
[*]Polished a lot of visual stuff about player's and camera's movement
[*]Made the Friend friendlier
[*]And finally finished the teaser for the Steam page
[/list]

And that's fairly some of the most important stuff that we did for the game within these 2 months.
I really appreciate everyone who has been supporting us through the development of this, giving ideas and helping with creation of it all and I can't thank enough for the kindness of our friends and family in this project.
Thank you all so much and we can't wait to bring you more stuff ahead :)
